meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 把任务拆成分阶段实施计划:先让子代理阅读文档和现成代码,主代理再统一整理。每阶段含实现目标、文档出处、验证清单和禁止事项,最后做一次总核验。
howto.when: 当用户要求规划某个功能、任务或多步实现时触发,尤其是在执行 do 之前。

say.text: 帮我给新用户引导功能做个分阶段实施计划
say.note: 会先查文档再产出阶段计划

say.text: 把这个任务拆成分阶段的实现步骤

say.text: 先读文档,再规划这个功能的改动方案

howto.what_en: Breaks a task into a phased implementation plan: subagents gather facts from docs/code, orchestrator consolidates. Each phase lists implementation goals, doc references, verification checklist, and anti-pattern guards; ends with final verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Create a phased implementation plan for the onboarding feature.
say_en.note: It will first gather docs, then produce the plan.

say_en.text: Break this task into staged implementation steps.
say_en.note: Outputs a plan with verification checklists.

say_en.text: Read the docs first, then plan how to change this feature.
